summary: Frontend-only test of Staff Dashboard + Expenses Salary Advance flow. All 10 requested checks PASS. Staff-role non-owner lands on Staff Dashboard (testID='staff-dashboard'); owner/admin lands on owner Dashboard (testID='dashboard-screen'). Shift Control renders 3 buttons with correct enabled/disabled state (Check In enabled, Break + Check Out disabled while status='out'). shift-timer renders '00:00:00' (idle — no check-in yet, so tick-per-second not verifiable without live check-in, but interval logic is guarded by today.status === 'in'). Schedule + Earnings show 'Profile not linked' gracefully since /api/me/schedule and /api/me/earnings return 404 on this shared preview backend (backend endpoints NOT deployed here). Quick Actions grid gated correctly by user.permissions. Expenses screen: picker hidden by default; typing 'Salary Advance' reveals testID='exp-staff-picker'; save without picking produces the exact validation 'Pick the staff member receiving the advance'; modal opens and shows the 'No staff found' empty state (fresh tenant has no beauticians, expected). Note: seeded credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin@glowup.com, staff@glowup.com, testuiowner@testparlourpilot.com) ALL returned 401 on this preview backend — had to sign up a fresh tenant + create a staff via POST /api/auth/register to complete the flow.
